texts.preamble: P. Gopal Krishan vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 19 August, 2025 Author: R.K. Pattanaik Bench: R.K. Pattanaik In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack Crlrev No.589 of 2024 P. Gopal Krishan .... Petitioner Mr. Milan Kanungo, Senior Advocate along with Mr. S.R. Mohanty, Advocate -Versus- State of Odisha .... Opposite Party Ms. B. Dash, Asc Coram: Mr. Justice R.K. Pattanaik Order
texts.facts: 2. Instant revision is filed by the petitioner assailing the impugned order dated 22nd August, 2024 passed in connection with G.R. Case No.78 of 2016 by the learned S.D.J.M., Berhampur as at Annexure-4 corresponding to Gosaninuagaon P.S. Case No.06 of 2016, whereby, an application under Section 205 Cr.P.C. moved by him dispensing with his personal appearance during inquiry has been rejected.
texts.arguments: 3. Mr. Kanungo, learned Senior Advocate appearing for the petitioner refers to Annexure-3 and submits that the petitioner is a busy businessman and he is required to travel to different parts of India to look after his business affairs and hence, it is not possible for him to attend the Court in person on each date of posting, hence, such a request as per Section 205 Cr.P.C. was pressed into service but without considering and appreciating it in proper perspective, the learned Court below rejected the same followed by the impugned order as at Annexure-4. It is further submitted that unless the petitioner is allowed to be represented by a counsel before the learned Court below allowing such an application under Section 205 Cr.P.C. he would be subjected to immense inconvenience and hardship, the fact, which was completely lost sight of by the learned Court below, hence, the impugned decision by order dated 22 nd August, 2024 i.e. Annexure-4 is required to be interfered with followed by consequential directions issued. P. Gopal Krishan vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 19 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86470281/ 1 4. On the other hand, Ms. Dash, learned ASC for the State justifies the impugned order at Annexure-4 with the submission that the case is pending at the stage of commitment, whereas, the appearance of other two accused persons is awaited. It is further submitted that no reason has been assigned by the petitioner to avoid appearance before the learned Court below, hence, therefore, the application under Section 205 Cr.P.C. has been rightly rejected.
